title: Product Manufacturer's Obligation to Provide Adequate Instructions and Warnings

content.scenario: A product manufacturer is selling a product that requires specific usage instructions to prevent harm. The manufacturer needs to provide adequate instructions and warnings to the consumer.
content.outcome: The product manufacturer is liable to provide adequate instructions and warnings to the consumer, as the product may contain a manufacturing defect, be defective in design, or fail to conform to the express warranty, as per Section 84(1) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What are the obligations of a product manufacturer?
What happens if a product is defective?
How can a consumer protect themselves from harm caused by a product?
